one_line: Product in frame from second one in warm light, plus one POV shot from inside it.

q1_hook.what: 0:00 a woman lifts a baby in front of a cream castle tent, a tunnel in the foreground, sunset behind. Voiceover (transcript): 'אם גם אצליכם מחפשים כל פעם...'. Subtitle 'אם גם אצלכם מחפשים כל', then 'את הקטנטנים' enlarged at 0:02.
q1_hook.why: 'If you too keep looking for...' calls out parents of little ones and implies an unmet need (H1, K6). Voice and subtitle start together (H6). The tent and tunnel are in frame from 0:00, but the brand is named only at about 0:05 and the need itself is vague (H3, H2).

beats.what: Woman lifts a baby before the tent and tunnel at sunset; 'אם גם אצלכם מחפשים כל'
beats.why: Callout over a warm, pretty scene.

beats.what: A woman crouches at the tunnel end, the baby sits facing it; 'את סט האוהל והמנהרה של בליס'
beats.why: Product and brand named, tent and tunnel in one frame.

beats.what: Wide shot, she puts toys in the tent; 'מעבר למשחק עצמו הוא משתלב בצורה מושלמת'
beats.why: A design claim over a calm shot.

beats.what: Baby sits in the tent with toys, smiling; 'צבעוני שמבלגן', 'ההרכבה לוקחת באמת כמה שניות'
beats.why: Claims said over a child; assembly is not shown.

beats.what: Baby at the opening, then crawls out; 'מתקפל בקלות', 'קל לניקוי', 'ללא BPA', 'של מכון התקנים'
beats.why: Answers safety and care doubts, but only in words.

beats.what: POV from inside the tunnel, a baby crawls toward the camera; 'כך שאפשר להיות רגועים'
beats.why: The most vivid shot: the product's own point of view.

beats.what: A man holds the baby before the tent at sunset; 'סט האוהל והמנהרה של בליס', 'הבחירה הנכונה'
beats.why: A calm recommendation close; no action asked.

q2_flow.interaction_prompts: None. No question, no send or save ask, no comment word in the video or the caption.
q2_flow.why: After the callout, the middle is a spec list read aloud over a baby sitting and crawling, with little new per shot (R3). A new picture every 2 to 4 s helps, but 0:09 to 0:18 is facts over a static tent. The tunnel POV at 0:19 is the one real moment; the last 7 s hold one shot (R1).

q3_cta.what: None. The spoken close is a recommendation, 'סט האוהל והמנהרה של בליס הוא לגמרי הבחירה הנכונה' (transcript), shown as 'הבחירה הנכונה' (0:27). Caption: a product line and '@bliss.il'. No link, code or price.
q3_cta.why: A recommendation is a soft close, not an action. A parent who wants the set must search for the brand: no link, price or where to buy (C6). No question or reason to send it to a friend either (C4, R6).

q4_shown.what: The cream tent and tunnel on a patio from 0:00; a baby in the tent 0:09 to 0:13, crawling out 0:15 to 0:18; a POV from inside the tunnel 0:19; a man holding the baby 0:21 to 0:28. No assembly, label or price.
q4_shown.why: The baby is seen using the tent and tunnel, real proof of use (S1, K5). The claims buyers weigh most, set-up in seconds, folding, BPA-free and the standard, are only said, with no demo or label on screen (K4).

q5_edit.what: 11 shots in 28 s (about 2.4 s each, the last about 7 s). Straight cuts on the voiceover, mostly static framing; no speed changes seen. Subtitles in 1 to 3 word chunks, key words larger. Ends on a man and baby at sunset.
q5_edit.why: A cut every 1 to 4 s on each new clause is a moderate pace (E2, R3). Subtitles carry every sentence in the lowest band, close to a transcript (E4, T2, T4). The last 7 s are one static shot after the information is done (R1, E8).

q6_topic.what: A play tent and tunnel set as a calm, design-friendly play corner for babies. Serves parents who want baby gear that suits their home.
q6_topic.why: It speaks to a real home worry, toys that take over the room, and to safety (K6). The content is a feature list read aloud with no story or personal moment (K2, K4).

q7_filmed.what: Phone, mostly static at eye level, medium to wide, on a covered patio at golden hour with a garden and sunset behind; one handheld shot at the start; one low POV from inside the tunnel. A woman, a man and a baby on camera.
q7_filmed.why: Golden-hour light and a clean cream product on green make the product the star, in a homemade but pretty way (H8, F7). Wide static shots show the whole tent but the baby is small (F4). The tunnel POV fills the frame (F5).

q8_text.on_screen: White bold sans-serif with a black outline, 1 to 3 words per chunk, near the bottom at about 88 to 94% of the frame height, key words larger: 'אם גם אצלכם מחפשים כל' (0:01), 'את הקטנטנים' (0:02), 'את סט האוהל והמנהרה של בליס' (0:05), 'קל לניקוי' (0:16), 'כך שאפשר להיות רגועים' (0:20), 'הבחירה הנכונה' (0:27). No headline card, no CTA.
q8_text.caption: 'סט האוהל + המנהרה של Bliss', then 'שעות של משחק, רגעים של קסם ועיצוב שמשתלב בכל פינה בבית ✨' and '@bliss.il'. Two short lines. No hashtags, question, CTA or disclosure word.
q8_text.why: Subtitles help muted viewers (T1), but they are near-transcript and at the very bottom, under the caption and button area (T2, T4, F2). The caption names the product and the home-design promise (T7) but has no hashtags. The brand is tagged, yet no disclosure word shows (T8, S7).

weak_points: Safety and set-up claims said but never shown; subtitles at the very bottom; no CTA, price or link; no disclosure word; a 7 s static ending; a brand script with no personal story.
lumebook_takeaway: Book in frame from second one in window light, one POV shot over the shoulder at the opened page, and show the claim you say. Hands only.
not_verified: Whether the posters are the baby's parents, and whether the post is paid. The verb in the first line is not visible in the sampled subtitle frames; the machine transcript 'להסיק' is likely a mishearing. Music (none evident). Correction: subtitles sit at about 88 to 94% of frame height, lower than the first pass's lower third; the brand is named at about 0:05.
